Registered interfaces remain constraints on this view. Algorithm calls: IF-PRED-OBS, IF-SELECT-ADMIT, IF-EXECUTE-RECORD, IF-OBS-INTERPRET, IF-PREP-RECOVER, IF-HIST-UPDATE, IF-EQUIV, IF-RESOURCE-STOP. Experiment I/O: IF-EXP-SCENE, IF-EXP-INJECT, IF-EXP-TRUTH, IF-EXP-COLLECT, IF-EXP-RUN, IF-EXP-FILTER, IF-EXP-EVAL. Campaigns: EXP-CLTAV-DETECT, EXP-CLTAV-LOCATE, EXP-CLTAV-ABLATION. Arms: CL-T / CL-A / CL-TA / CL-LOOP. Truth is evaluator-only and is never an algorithm input. The truth-to-run edge is forbidden leakage. This note records the interface boundary; it is not a measured result.
